title: LLMCompass: Enabling Efficient Hardware Design for Large Language Model Inference
problem: Large language model inference requires prohibitively expensive hardware, and evaluating different hardware designs for LLM inference is a significant bottleneck due to computational requirements.
motivation: Enabling efficient hardware design for LLM inference is critical to democratize LLMs and reduce their prohibitive computational and cost overhead.
method: LLMCompass is a hardware evaluation framework that includes an automated mapper to find performance-optimal mapping and scheduling, and an area-based cost model for architectural reasoning. It accurately models hardware behavior with 10.9% average error on operators and 4.1% error on full LLM inference. The framework can simulate complex systems like 4-NVIDIA A100 GPU nodes running GPT-3 175B in 16 minutes.
key_novelty: A fast and accurate hardware evaluation framework with automated performance-optimal mapping that enables rapid exploration of cost-effective hardware designs for LLM inference.
contributions: LLMCompass hardware evaluation framework for LLM inference workloads achieving high accuracy (4.1% error) with fast simulation
Automated mapper for finding performance-optimal mapping and scheduling with 26,400 parameter search rounds
Area-based cost model supporting architectural reasoning about design choices
Exploration of cost-effective hardware designs achieving 3.41x performance/cost improvement through reduced compute or HBM-to-DRAM replacement

metrics.accuracy: 10.9% error rate for operators, 4.1% error for LLM inference
metrics.other: 16 minute simulation time for 4-NVIDIA A100 GPU node with GPT-3 175B inference

primary_theme: efficient hardware evaluation for LLM inference
